values.note: Every campsite is a 'Campsite Electric' with water. 55 sites are $34 a night and 109 are $40 (same price Tuesday 2026-11-10, Saturday 2026-11-14 and Saturday 2027-06-19; $238 / $280 a week). Tent-only walk-in sites $20-22. The park page: 'Overnight guests pay daily ParkPass fee only once per vehicle during their stay ... Parking is not included with reservation.'

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/elijah-clark-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530151 (site pages: e.g. Campsite 006 '$34.00 Per Night', Campsite 005 '$40.00 Per Night' on all three sampled dates) + https://gastateparks.org/ElijahClark (Parking: 'Fee required'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: gastateparks.reserveamerica.com parkId 530151 site details (172 'Campsite Electric' sites, all 'Water Hookup: Y'; 'Electricity Hookup: 50' at 22 public sites - 023-043, 074, 109 - and 30 at the rest; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' only at the 8 sites named Host) + park map legend '30 AMP Campsites' / '50 AMP Campsites', read 2026-10-29

values.note: 172 electric sites on the booking site, 8 of them camp-host sites (079, 201-207), leaving 164 for the public: 161 take a 23-ft rig ('Max Vehicle Length' 30-50 ft; 067, 088 and 158 are 20 ft); 54 are pull-throughs. Two loops: Campground #1 (sites 1-88) and Campground #2 (89-166). Plus 10 tent-only walk-in sites and a pioneer camp.
